$doc: Frozen test set for the ship-gate. Owned by david@happy.ai. Adding/removing images requires an isolated PR. The gate runner refuses to start if any source DNG is missing.
$rules: Never add an image you picked for a specific run.
Never remove an image because a pipeline fails on it. Failing the gate IS the answer.
Crop positions are pixel-fixed. Don't 'recenter' a crop to make it look better.
Characteristics field is descriptive, not a workaround — every image counts for every gate.

metric_eval_dims.$doc: Single downsample target for all metric computation. Prevents picking 'easy' resolutions.

crops.$doc: 100% crop positions in source-DNG pixel coords. Same coords across all images even if content differs.

images.notes: Dark rocks with fine texture; high spatial frequency content. Detail-A crop is the canonical hard case for blockiness/cross-hatch artifacts.
Sky/horizon with mostly low frequencies. Easy case; if a pipeline fails this, it's seriously broken.
Studio shot with sharp edges and texture. Stresses high-frequency preservation.
